hook: Your map of Afghanistan has a strange arm.
title: Afghanistan Has an Arm That Touches China
description:
Look at a map of Afghanistan and you'll see the Wakhan Corridor, a thin arm of land about 350 km long that stretches east until it touches China. Britain and Russia shaped it in the 1890s so their empires wouldn't border each other. Part of the Places That Shouldn't Exist series.

#Shorts #PlacesThatShouldntExist #Geography
comment_prompt: Did you know this? Yes or no
